what_this_is: Writing recipes kept in tools/write-from-a-recipe: each one instruction over the person's text (work_item.text) and the answers it asks for (work_item.fields, with choices and defaults), rendered by read-data/compose-instruction.mjs. Converted from bitfield-packages packages/content-actions action rows: the instruction template is one { line } segment, the typed text is work_item.text and each asked answer is the work item field of its id. Adding a recipe is adding a row.
